selection_reason: All 27 remaining original tasks. Added after all 18 parity cells of the initial pilot replayed at 100% primary accuracy, while its depth controls were still running. Covers the complete original 35-task inventory in two disjoint cohorts; no failed pilot cell is replaced.
training_protocol: Unchanged counts-v1 binary and embedded protocol. Only the planned task inventory expands; original data, scales, caps, batch sizes and metrics remain fixed.
